question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate idiom that can replace the underlined phrase in the following sentence.**

He is experienced and **__full of wisdom__** as he is teaching chemistry at a university at a very young age of 25.
solution:
The correct answer is **"old head on young shoulders."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Full of wisdom" **is a phrase used to describe someone who possesses a great deal of knowledge, experience, and good judgment. (कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसके पास बहुत सारा ज्ञान, अनुभव और अच्छा निर्णय हो)

 
 
• **Example**: *He is **full of wisdom**__.*
 
 
 
• The idiom **"old head on young shoulders"** means that someone is wise and mature beyond their years. (कोई व्यक्ति अपनी उम्र से अधिक बुद्धिमान और परिपक्व होता है)
 __
 
• **Example**: *He is *an ***old head on young shoulders**__.*
 
 
 
• In the sentence, it is used to describe the young teacher's experience and wisdom.
 
• The idiom is grammatically correct and fits well in the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 2 (a frog in a small pond)** means someone who is important or successful only in a small or limited environment. (कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति जो केवल छोटे या सीमित वातावरण में ही महत्वपूर्ण या सफल हो)
 
• **Option 3 (an alpha mom)** refers to a mother who is dominant and assertive in her parenting style. (एक माँ जो अपनी पालन-पोषण शैली में प्रभावशाली और दृढ़ है)
 
• **Option 4 (a silver fox)** is used to describe an attractive older man with gray or silver hair. (भूरे या चांदी के बालों वाले एक आकर्षक वृद्ध व्यक्ति का वर्णन करना)
